The NetRTK satellite view in the Anthbot: The NetRTK satellite view in the Anthbot app primarily describes the RTK base station. Kevin has his own GNSS receiver. The adapter therefore keeps base and mower values strictly separate. Live values are available below each device at diagnostics.gnss. Missing values are shown as unknown instead of being guessed.
